- Bump commons-io:commons-io from 2.21.0 to 2.22.0 ([#11980](https://github.com/apache/maven/pull/11980)) @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot)
- Bump com.google.guava:guava from 33.5.0-jre to 33.6.0-jre ([#11951](https://github.com/apache/maven/pull/11951)) @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot)
- Bump actions/cache from 5.0.4 to 5.0.5 ([#11943](https://github.com/apache/maven/pull/11943)) @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot)
